Success Story
Konain Zahra Maqbool's academic journey is a powerful story of determination, resilience, and breaking barriers. Hailing from the Baltistan region where access to international academic opportunities is limited, she dared to dream beyond boundaries and worked persistently to turn that dream into reality.
As a graduate of the Department of Botany, University of Baltistan, Konain consistently demonstrated academic excellence, curiosity for scientific research, and a deep commitment to Botany. Her passion for sustainable plant production and scientific innovation motivated her to pursue advanced studies at the global level.
Her selection for the Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship, one of the world's most competitive and prestigious fully funded scholarships, marks a historic achievement. She is the first female from Baltistan and the first alumna of the Department of Botany to earn this honor, setting a precedent for future generations of students, especially young women from remote and underserved regions.
Currently based in Japan, Konain is actively engaged in Master's research in Plant Production Sciences, where she is gaining advanced knowledge, international research exposure, and cross-cultural academic experience. Her work not only contributes to scientific advancement but also holds the potential to positively impact agricultural development back home.
Konain Zahra Maqbool stands as a beacon of inspiration proving that with dedication, mentorship, and institutional support, students from Gilgit-Baltistan can compete and excel on the global academic stage. Her success reflects the growing academic strength of the University of Baltistan and reinforces its mission to nurture globally competent scholars.

Introduction
The Directorate of Academics at University of Baltistan, Skardu is the central authority responsible for planning, developing, and maintaining the highest standards of academic excellence across all faculties and departments. We ensure that academic programs are aligned with national and international standards, foster innovation in teaching and learning, and promote research-based education. Our directorate serves as the backbone of the university's academic framework, coordinating curriculum development, faculty development, quality assurance, and academic governance. We work to create an environment where academic excellence thrives, ensuring that students receive quality education that prepares them for professional success and societal contributions. Dr. Ghulam Raza
Director Academics
director.academics@uobs.edu.pk
Mission
To develop and implement innovative academic policies, promote excellence in teaching and learning, and ensure the highest quality of education that meets national and international standards. We strive to create a dynamic learning environment that fosters intellectual growth, critical thinking, and professional development for both students and faculty members, ultimately contributing to the socio-economic development of the region and the nation. Vision
To become a nationally recognized center of academic excellence that produces globally competent graduates, fosters innovation, and contributes to the socio-economic development of the region. We envision a university where academic programs are benchmarked against international standards, where research informs teaching, and where graduates are equipped with the knowledge, skills, and values to lead positive change in their communities and beyond. Semester Rules & Academic Regulations

Semester Structure
Academic year consists of two regular semesters: Fall (September-December) and Spring (February-May)
Each semester spans 16-18 weeks including teaching, examinations, and breaks

Minimum 75% attendance required in each course for exam eligibility

Below 65% attendance results in course repetition

Continuous assessment: 40% (Assignments, quizzes, presentations, mid-term)

What is the deadline for PEF Scholarship 2026? The deadline for PEF Scholarship 2026 submission is April 17, 2026. Incomplete or inaccurate applications will not be considered. What are the eligibility requirements for PEF Scholarship? To be eligible, you must be regularly enrolled at UoBS on open merit, have intermediate score not below 65%, and monthly family income not exceeding PKR 75,000/-. Where do I submit the PEF application form? Completed application forms along with all required documents must be submitted to the Student Financial Aid Office or Treasurer Office at University of Baltistan, Skardu. How do I apply for Need-Based or Kinship Scholarship? Please visit the Student Financial Aid Office at the University campus. The office hours are Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM. Do I need to reapply every year? Most scholarships require annual renewal based on academic performance. Some automatically renew if you maintain the required CGPA, while others require fresh applications. Are part-time students eligible for scholarships? Most scholarships are for full-time regular students only.

Introduction
The Directorate of Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC) at the University of Baltistan, Skardu (UoBS), serves as the central regulatory body dedicated to maintaining and elevating the standards of higher education. Established under the guidelines of the Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan, the Directorate's core mandate is to implement a robust quality assurance framework that aligns with the National Qualification Framework (NQF). It functions as a bridge between the university's academic activities and national quality benchmarks, ensuring that every degree program meets the highest rigorous standards. The Directorate is committed to fostering a culture of academic integrity and continuous improvement. It actively oversees the evaluation of teaching and research through systematic feedback from students, alumni, and stakeholders. A key priority of the QEC is the capacity building of faculty and staff; it regularly organizes workshops on pedagogical skills, fair assessment techniques, and the preparation of Self-Assessment Reports (SARs) for various departments. By prioritizing transparency and efficiency, the QEC ensures that UoBS provides a competitive learning environment. Our mission remains focused on creating a synergy between curriculum development, innovative research, and student-centered learning, ultimately transforming the university into a premier institution of global academic excellence. Prof. Dr. Abdul Matin
Director QEC
director.qec@uobs.edu.pk
Mission, Vision & Objectives
Mission
The Directorate of Quality Enhancement Cell is committed to fostering a culture of academic excellence at the University of Baltistan, Skardu, by implementing robust quality assurance frameworks aligned with HEC standards. We strive to enhance teaching, research, and institutional efficiency through continuous monitoring, systematic feedback, and capacity building, ensuring our graduates and academic programs meet the highest national and international benchmarks of success. Vision
To transform the University of Baltistan, Skardu, into a premier seat of learning recognized for global academic excellence. We envision a future where a self-sustaining culture of quality, innovation, and integrity permeates every aspect of the university, ensuring our graduates are internationally competitive and our institutional standards serve as a benchmark for higher education in the region and beyond. Objectives
• Implement HEC quality frameworks
• Monitor academic program standards
• Enhance faculty teaching skills
• Collect systematic stakeholder feedback
• Prepare departmental assessment reports

Key Achievement
Upon joining the University of Baltistan, Skardu, as Additional Director QEC on February 07, 2022, Dr. Attarad Ali did not receive any official QEC records or documentation despite repeated requests to the former Director QEC and relevant offices. In the absence of institutional handover, he independently initiated the establishment of the QEC in its true spirit by developing a comprehensive documentation system and operational framework. Through sustained diligence and commitment, he led the institutional transition toward PSG-2023, coordinated departments to fulfil the requirements of the respective accreditation councils, ensured the implementation of HEC policies and procedures, convened five (05) IQC meetings chaired by the VC, formulated more than 25 institutional policies through the IQC, developed institutional and academic strategic plans, designed KPIs for administrative and academic directorates and heads, and successfully conducted the first Self-RIPE of UoBS, including the Corrective Action Plan, in line with the HEC Revamped QA Framework.

Faculty Councils are academic bodies responsible for coordinating and supervising teaching, research, and examination activities within their respective faculties. They ensure academic standards and facilitate inter-departmental collaboration.
Recommend curriculum development and revisions for undergraduate and postgraduate programs
Approve course contents, syllabi, and reading materials for all programs
Coordinate and promote research activities within the faculty
Oversee student admissions, examinations, and academic progression
Recommend faculty appointments, promotions, and development programs
Prepare academic calendar and schedule of examinations
Facilitate collaboration between departments within the faculty
Monitor academic standards and quality assurance measures
Approve research proposals and thesis topics for postgraduate students
Recommend conferment of degrees to the Academic Council
Address student grievances related to academic matters
Coordinate with other faculties and academic bodies of the university

content: سکردو (مورخہ 4 ستمبر 2026ء) بلتستان یونیورسٹی سکردو میں دفتر ایس اے (اسٹوڈنٹ ایڈوائزر) کے زیرِ اہتمام اور بمناسبت ولادت باسعادت سرکارِ دو عالم حضرت محمد ﷺ سلسلہ ہائے دروس کا تیسرا سیشن منعقد کیا گیا۔”حفاظتِ ماحول اور نبوی ہدایات: حیاتیاتی تنوع اور قدرتی وسائل کا استعمال“ کے عنوان سے منعقدہ تیسرے سیشن میں عالمی شہرت یافتہ مذہبی اسکالر ڈاکٹر معصومہ جعفری نے بطور مہمانِ مقرر خطاب کیا جبکہ سیشن میں اساتذہ اور طلباء و طالبات کی ایک بڑی تعداد موجود تھی۔ اس موقع پر وائس چانسلر پروفیسر ڈاکٹر مسعود اختر نے اپنے پیغام میں کہا کہ سیرتِ طیبہﷺ ہمیں فطرت کا احترام، ماحول کی صفائی اور قدرتی وسائل کا مخلصانہ و متوازن استعمال سیکھاتی ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ حیاتیاتی تنوع اور درختوں و پانی کا تحفظ دراصل سیرتِ پیغمبر اسلام ﷺ پر عمل پیرا ہونے کا بہترین عملی ذریعہ ہے، لہٰذا میں یونیورسٹی کے اساتذہ اور طلبہ کو دعوت دیتا ہوں کہ وہ سیرتِ نبوی ﷺ کی روشنی میں ماحول کو سرسبز اور متوازن بنانے میں اپنا فعال کردار ادا کریں۔ اسٹوڈنٹ ایڈوائزر ڈاکٹر محمد ریاض نے سیمینار کے اغراض و مقاصد پر روشنی ڈالتے ہوئے کہا کہ سلسلہ وار دروس کا مقصد نوجوانوں میں یہ احساس بیدار کرنا ہے کہ ماحول کی حفاظت صرف ایک شہری ذمہ داری نہیں بلکہ اہم دینی و اخلاقی فریضہ اور سنتِ رسول اللہ ﷺ بھی ہے۔ ان کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ دنیا بھر میں درپیش ماحولیاتی بحران اور حیاتیاتی تنوع کے نقصان کا حل سیرتِ طیبہ ﷺ کی روشنی میں ہی ممکن ہے تاکہ لوگ اسلامی تعلیمات کے ذریعے ماحول سے محبت اور اس کی پاسداری سیکھ سکیں۔ مہمانِ خصوصی عالمی شہرت یافتہ مذہبی اسکالر ڈاکٹر معصومہ جعفری نے اپنے خطاب کے آغاز میں سورۂ رحمن کی آیاتِ مبارکہ کی تلاوت کرتے ہوئے خطہ گلگت بلتستان کی سلامتی، قدرتی وسائل کے تحفظ اور یہاں کے باسیوں کی عاقبت بالخیر کے لیے دعائیہ کلمات کہے۔ انہوں نے بلتستان یونیورسٹی کے تعلیمی ماحول، خوبصورت عمارت اور نوجوانوں کے علمی جذبے کی تعریف کرتے ہوئے یونیورسٹی اِنتظامیہ کا شکریہ ادا کیا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے انسانیت کی تخلیق سے پہلے ہی ان کی تمام ضروریات کو مدنظر رکھتے ہوئے یہ قدرتی ماحول اور کائنات کا توازن قائم کیا اور قرآنِ مجید کی روشنی میں انسان اس زمین پر صرف نفع اُٹھانے والا نہیں بلکہ قدرت کی تمام نعمتوں جیسے پانی، ہوا، درخت اور پہاڑوں کا امین اور خلیفہ ہے۔ انہوں نے افسوس کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ انسان نے جب اپنے مفاد اور لالچ کے لیے قدرت کے نظام میں مداخلت کی تو زمین و فضا میں فساد برپا ہوا جس کے نتیجے میں آج فضائی و آبی آلودگی اور گلگت بلتستان سمیت دنیا بھر میں سیلاب اور فطری وسائل کی کمی جیسے شدید بحران جنم لے رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ قرآن کریم میں تقریباً 750 آیات ایسی ہیں جو براہِ راست یا بالواسطہ نیچر اور قدرتی وسائل کا احاطہ کرتی ہیں جبکہ متعدد سورتوں کے نام بھی حیوانات اور فطرت کے مظاہر پر رکھے گئے ہیں۔ فرمانِ نبوی ﷺ کا حوالہ دیتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ اگر قیامت قائم ہو رہی ہو اور تم میں سے کسی کے ہاتھ میں پودے کی ایک چھوٹی سی شاخ ہو تو اسے چاہیے کہ قیامت سے پہلے اس پودے کو زمین میں لگا دے۔ انہوں نے زور دیا کہ ماحولیات کا تحفظ صرف ایک سائنسی ضرورت نہیں بلکہ ہر مسلمان کی اخلاقی اور دینی ذمہ داری ہے اور تمام طلبہ و اساتذہ اپنے خطے کی قدرتی پاکیزگی کو برقرار رکھنے کے لیے عملی اقدامات کریں۔سیشن کے آغاز میں تلاوتِ کلامِ پاک کی سعادت شعبہ باٹنی کے طالب علم حافظ نوازش علی نے حاصل کی جبکہ نعتِ رسول مقبول ﷺ پیش کرنے کا شرف شعبہ اُردو کی طالبہ قرۃ العین کو حاصل ہوا۔

Introduction
Under the provision of the University of Baltistan Order 2016, clause 4. Powers and purpose of the University, subsection (viii) and (xvii) the university shall: institute programs for the exchange of students and teachers between the University and other universities, educational institutions and research organizations, inside as well as outside Pakistan” ; and
“cooperate and build linkages with other universities, institutions, public authorities or private organizations, inside as well outside Pakistan, in such manner and for such purposes as it may prescribe”. With formal functioning of University of Baltistan, in 2018 after arrival of the founding Vice Chancellor, realizing the potential and need of outreach for the new the university, the Directorate of External Linkages was established. The responsibility of Director External Linkages was assigned to Dr. Zakir Hussain Zakir as the founding Director. The directorate reached out expeditiously to create social space of the University among national and international institutions and organizations. The directorate also strived to register the nascent university on different forums of university ranking. So far 60+ Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) and letters of agreements have been signed. The primary aim of these MoUs were to introduce the University as a potential collaborating partner for academic linkages, research and development. Dr. Shafqat Hussain
Director External Linkages
director.external.linkages@uobs.edu.pk
Mission, Vision & Objectives
Mission
To create, strengthen, enrich and expand linkages with relevant national and international stakeholders prospective partners, for quality learning opportunities and research practices, through collaborative efforts so that the university becomes a basecamp of research, innovation and a learning site for knowledge creation.. Vision
An institution of higher learning known to global academia and development agencies as a trusted academic partner with whom institutions would feel proud to collaborate. Objectives
• Introduce the university as a highly potential academic institution for partnership for R&D in the contextually relevant resources and services
• Beautify and enrich the real social image of the region and the country as the most beautiful and peaceful places rich in natural and cultural beauties and resources
• Collaborate with prospective stakeholders for partnership endeavors in learning, research and development
• Build and maintain a strong link of collaborative efforts with communities and partners for the betterment of the University and the region
• Translate the partnership commitments into practical outcomes in form of knowledge generation, learning opportunities, research outcomes and innovative products
• Reach out to international prospective partners for collaboration in areas of mutual interest
• Formulate partnership deeds for win-win projects without any liability on the university

About Baltistan
The Majestic Land of Giants - Where Nature, Culture, and History Converge
Land of Majestic Mountains
Baltistan is a region of exceptional natural beauty, cultural richness, and strategic significance, located in the northernmost part of Pakistan. Renowned for its towering peaks, pristine valleys, and historic heritage, Baltistan is home to some of the world’s highest mountains, including K2. The region is distinguished by its resilient and hospitable people, deep-rooted traditions, and a strong sense of community. Baltistan’s unique geographic position and cultural diversity make it not only a place of scenic wonder but also a center of emerging educational, economic, and social development.
With its breathtaking landscapes and peaceful environment, Baltistan offers an ideal setting for learning, research, and innovation. The region is increasingly recognized for its potential in tourism, climate studies, sustainable development, and mountain research. As an area rich in history and opportunity, Baltistan continues to inspire progress while preserving its heritage, making it a vital part of Pakistan’s national identity and future growth.
Geographic Significance
A region defined by its dramatic landscapes and ecological importance
Mountain Ranges
Home to the Karakoram Range with four of the world's fourteen 8,000-meter peaks, including K2, Gasherbrum I & II, and Broad Peak.
Water Resources
Source of the Indus River, with massive glaciers including Siachen (world's longest outside polar regions) and Baltoro.
Biodiversity
Unique high-altitude ecosystems supporting snow leopards, Marco Polo sheep, Himalayan brown bears, and endemic plant species.

About VC Secretariat
The Vice Chancellor’s Secretariat serves as the central executive office of the University of Baltistan, Skardu. It provides strategic, administrative, and coordination support to the Vice Chancellor in the execution of academic, administrative, financial, and policy matters of the University. The Secretariat ensures smooth communication between the Vice Chancellor and all statutory bodies, academic departments, administrative offices, external stakeholders, and regulatory authorities. It plays a pivotal role in policy implementation, institutional planning, and monitoring of university activities. The office upholds professionalism, confidentiality, efficiency, and transparency while facilitating decision-making processes. Through effective coordination and timely execution of tasks, the Secretariat contributes significantly to achieving the University's vision of academic excellence and institutional development.
Our Mission
The mission of the Vice Chancellor’s Secretariat is to provide efficient, transparent, and strategic support to the Vice Chancellor in implementing the University’s policies and vision. It coordinates academic, research, and operational activities across all departments and directorates, facilitates collaboration with national and international partners and regulatory bodies, and ensures timely execution of decisions, effective communication, and proper documentation to uphold governance, accountability, and institutional excellence.

title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content:
Event Overview
The University of Baltistan, Skardu (UOBS) observed Youm-e-Istehsal Kashmir with a commemorative programme to express solidarity with the people of Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu and Kashmir (IIOJK) and to reaffirm support for their internationally recognized right to self-determination. The event was attended by members of the University's administration, faculty, staff, and students. Participants expressed solidarity with the people of Jammu and Kashmir and reiterated their support for the peaceful pursuit of their fundamental rights. The programme also highlighted the importance of raising awareness of the humanitarian and human rights dimensions of the Kashmir issue. In his message on the occasion, Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Masood Akhtar stated that organizing programmes on important national issues is part of the University's academic, civic, and moral responsibility. "Universities have an important role in promoting informed dialogue, civic awareness, and responsible engagement with issues of national and international significance. We remain committed to providing platforms for constructive discussion and to expressing solidarity with the people of Jammu and Kashmir in accordance with Pakistan's principled position on their right to self-determination," he said. Addressing the participants, Registrar Dr. Mir Alam emphasized the University's continued moral and diplomatic support for the people of Jammu and Kashmir. He called upon the international community to pay greater attention to reported human rights concerns and urged renewed efforts toward a peaceful and just resolution of the Kashmir dispute in accordance with relevant United Nations Security Council resolutions. Speaking on the occasion, Lecturer Aftab highlighted the role of young people and educational institutions in promoting awareness of global issues. He encouraged students to engage with international affairs through informed academic discourse, research, and responsible advocacy, emphasizing that universities serve as important forums for fostering critical thinking and civic responsibility. The programme concluded with a collective call for the international community to support efforts aimed at ensuring that the people of Jammu and Kashmir are able to exercise their right to self-determination through peaceful means in accordance with relevant United Nations resolutions. The University of Baltistan reaffirmed its commitment to promoting informed academic dialogue, civic responsibility, peace, and respect for human rights through educational activities and public engagement.

Introduction
The Faculty of Education, Humanities, and Social Sciences (FoEHSS) at the University of Baltistan, Skardu (UoBS) lays the foundation stone for preservation and promotion of intellectual, cultural, and social development in Gilgit-Baltistan. This Faculty i. e. FoEHSS has enthusiastically been established to advancing knowledge that fortifies education systems, encourages indigenous intellect, conserves cultural heritage, and respond enduring social and economic challenges of the countrymen and the Republic. The FoEHSS offers transdisciplinary academic programmes that blend education, languages, culture, economics, and social inquiry, cultivating critical thinking, ethical leadership, and civic responsibility. The FoEHSS prepares educators, researchers, policy practitioners, and community leaders capable of addressing to local realities while engaging with national and global discourses. Diversity and inclusion are at our core, fostering a vibrant environment where creativity and collaboration thrive. The FoEHSS makes a concerted labour enriching the educational experience of students for their success in academic life at UoBS and professional life beyond UoBS. As we look ahead, we remain committed to excellence, innovation, and shaping a better future for all. Rooted in the unique historical, linguistic, and cultural landscape of the Karakoram–Himalayan region, the FoEHSS places strong emphasis on indigenous knowledge systems, cultural heritage, and social cohesion while promotes modern pedagogical approaches, evidence-informed research, and policy-relevant scholarship aligned with national development priorities and global frameworks such as sustainable development and global citizenship. We believe in refining intellect, preserving heritage, and forming future with the forte of inclusivity in all its manifestations. Our Mission
To provide quality academic programmes, foster impactful research, strengthen teacher education and leadership, integrate indigenous knowledge with global perspectives, and prepare ethical graduates committed to social responsibility and transformative community development. Our Vision
To become a premier center of excellence in education, humanities, and social sciences that bridges traditional knowledge with contemporary societal needs. Key Focus Areas

Welcome to the Faculty of Education, Humanities and Social Sciences (FoEHSS) which represents the intellectual, cultural, and social foundation of the University of Baltistan, Skardu (UoBS). Situated at the crossroads of South and Central Asia, Gilgit-Baltistan holds immense potential for sustainable economic development, entrepreneurship, trade, and tourism. In a region characterised by linguistic diversity, rich cultural heritage, complex social structures, and evolving development challenges, FoEHSS plays a vital role in fostering critical thinking, cultural understanding, social cohesion, and evidence-based policymaking. Our programmes are designed to respond directly to regional needs while meeting national and international academic standards. We promote transdisciplinary teaching and research that address regional priorities of Gilgit-Baltistan while engaging with national and global academic discourses. title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content:
Success Story
Syed Shakir Hussain is a distinguished graduate from the inaugural cohort of the University of Baltistan in Skardu, making history as the first student from both his university and the Baltistan region to be accepted into a Master's program in China. Currently studying at the prestigious Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences (CAAS), China's leading agricultural research institute, he is advancing his education in the fields of agriculture, the environment, and energy.
Syed Shakir Hussain earned his Bachelor of Science in Botany at the University of Baltistan as part of its pioneering batch. Throughout his studies, he demonstrated exceptional academic performance, critical thinking abilities, and a growing passion for agriculture, environmental preservation, and biology. As one of the university's first graduates, he played a key role in shaping the early academic programs of his department. His burgeoning interest in research laid a strong foundation for his international academic journey.
Syed Shakir's academic excellence and research potential culminated in a rare and remarkable achievement: a fully funded Master's scholarship from CAAS, a first for both the University of Baltistan and the Baltistan region. After careful consideration, he accepted the offer, furthering his education at one of China's most prestigious research institutions.
At CAAS, Syed is focusing on waste management for biogas production, an essential area in renewable energy and environmental conservation. His research is dedicated to developing sustainable and effective methods to convert waste into energy, a crucial endeavor for regions like Gilgit-Baltistan, which face unique environmental and resource challenges.
Syed Shakir Hussain's success story highlights the growing strength of the University of Baltistan and its ability to prepare students for international achievement. His journey serves as an inspiration to students from remote and underserved areas, demonstrating that with perseverance, vision, and dedication, even those from the most challenging backgrounds can reach remarkable heights on the global stage.

Introduction
The Sports Directorate at the University of Baltistan (UoBs) plays a vital role in promoting physical fitness, teamwork, and a spirit of healthy competition among students. It is responsible for organizing and managing a wide range of sports activities, tournaments, and interdepartmental competitions throughout the academic year. The directorate aims to nurture talent, encourage student participation in both indoor and outdoor sports, and represent the university at regional and national levels. By providing facilities, training opportunities, and structured programs, the Sports Directorate contributes to the overall development and well-being of students at UoBs. In 2025, for the first time, the Sports Directorate got the chance to organize Sports Gala 2025 at our new campus. Governor Gilgit-Baltistan Syed Mehdi Shah inaugurated the newly built sports complex and appreciated the Sports Directorate for organizing and managing such a beautiful event. Furthermore, the directorate has always encouraged sports activities, whether inside the campus or outside. We enthusiastically participate in sports events organized by district administration and the Sports Board of Gilgit-Baltistan. We are hopeful that now we will participate in the Zonal and Regional sports events organized by the HEC in the future. Junaid Ahmad

زیرِ اہتمام یومِ آزادیِ پاکستان کی مناسبت سے مُنعقدہ دو روزہ سرگرمیاں اپنے تمام تر جوش و خروش، قومی جذبے اور شائقین کی بھرپور شرکت کے ساتھ اختتام پذیر ہو گئیں۔ دو روزہ سرگرمیوں کا باقاعدہ آغاز 13 اگست کو مختلف طلبہ مقابلوں سے ہوا جبکہ 14 اگست کی صبح یونیورسٹی کے چبوترے پر پرچم کشائی کی تقریب منعقد ہوئی۔ قومی ترانے کی گونج میں سرسبز و ہلال پرچم لہرایا گیا اور ملک کی سلامتی، استحکام اور ترقی کے لئے خصوصی دعائیں مانگی گئیں۔ اس پر موقع پر جشنِ آزادی کا کیک بھی کاٹا گیا۔ تقریب میں وائس چانسلر پروفیسر ڈاکٹر مسعود اختر، رئیسِ کلیہ سماجی علوم پروفیسر ڈاکٹر اشفاق احمد شاہ، رئیسِ کلیہ نیچرل سائنسز پروفیسر ڈاکٹر عبدالمتین، پرنسپل آفیسرز، شعبہ جات کے صدور، اساتذہ کرام اور طلباء و طالبات کی ایک بڑی تعداد نے شرکت کی اور قومی یکجہتی کا بھرپور مظاہرہ کیا۔ اس موقع پر تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے وائس چانسلر پروفیسر ڈاکٹر مسعود اختر نے اساتذہ اور طلبہ کے جذبے کو سراہتے ہوئے کہا کہ جشنِ آزادی محض ایک رواجی تہوار یا صرف پرچم لہرانے کا نام نہیں بلکہ یہ دن ہم سے عملی جدوجہد، سخت محنت اور غیر متزلزل عزم کا تقاضا کرتا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ ملک و قوم کی ترقی کا راز دیانت داری، اعلیٰ تعلیم اور مثبت سوچ میں پنہاں ہے اور ہمیں علم کی شمع روشن کرتے ہوئے پوری سچائی کے ساتھ وطنِ عزیز کی خدمت کرنی ہوگی۔ وائس چانسلر نے ارضِ پاک کے امن اور دفاع کے لئے سیکورٹی اداروں اور شہداء کی بے مثال قربانیوں کو زبردست خراجِ تحسین پیش کیا اور اس عزم کا اعادہ کیا کہ یونیورسٹی ان کی قربانیوں کی روشنی میں نئی نسل کی تعلیم و تربیت کے لئے اپنا موثر کردار ادا کرتی رہے گی۔ انہوں نے یونیورسٹی کی تعلیمی خدمات کو وسعت دینے کے عزم کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے اعلان کیا کہ بہت جلد یونیورسٹی کے تحت ایک جدید ماڈل اسکول قائم کیا جائے گا جو علاقے کے بچوں کو معیاری اور جدید ترین تعلیمی سہولیات فراہم کرے گا۔ پرچم کشائی کی تقریب کے بعد دو روزہ مقابلوں کے فائنل راؤنڈز کا انعقاد کیا گیا جس میں طلباء و طالبات نے اپنی خداداد صلاحیتوں کا مظاہرہ کیا۔ اُردو تقریری مقابلے کے سنسنی خیز فائنل میں شعبہ کمپیوٹر سائنس کی نہال علی اور شعبہ ایجوکیشنل ڈیولپمنٹ کی طاہرہ بتول نے مشترکہ طور پر پہلی جبکہ شعبہ لینگویجز اینڈ کلچرل اسٹڈیز کی علیزہ نے دوسری پوزیشن حاصل کی۔ انگریزی تقریری مقابلے میں شعبہ لینگویجز کی رضیہ حامد نے پہلی اور فوزیہ نے دوسری پوزیشن اپنے نام کی۔ فنِ مصوری کے مقابلے میں شعبہ ایجوکیشنل ڈیولپمنٹ کی ثریا نے اپنی بہترین تخلیقی صلاحیتوں کے بل بوتے پر پہلی پوزیشن حاصل کی جبکہ ملی نغموں کے مقابلے میں شعبہ زولوجی کے حسن نے روح پرور پیشکش پر پہلی اور یوشیع نے دوسری پوزیشن حاصل کی۔ کوئز کے کانٹے دار مقابلے میں شعبہ لینگویجز اینڈ کلچرل اسٹڈیز کی ٹیم ۔بی نے نمایاں کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے فائنل ٹرافی اپنے نام کی۔ تقاریب کے اختتامی مرحلے میں اسناد تقسیم کرنے کی پروقار تقریب منعقد ہوئی۔تقریب کے مہمانِ خصوصی وائس چانسلر پروفیسر ڈاکٹر مسعود اختر تھے۔ انہوں نے مختلف مقابلوں، فنِ مصوری، کوئز، تقریری مقابلوں اور ملی نغموں میں نمایاں پوزیشنیں حاصل کرنے والے طلبہ اور فاتح ٹیموں میں اسناد اور انعامات تقسیم کیے اور ان کی Vice Chancellor's Message
A Message from Prof. Dr. Masood Akhtar, Vice Chancellor of University of Baltistan, Skardu
It is my privilege to welcome you to the University of Baltistan, Skardu, an emerging center of higher learning in the country. It is located in one of the world's most magnificent mountain regions, where the Himalayas meet the Karakoram and the timeless Indus River shapes its cultural and intellectual landscape. Baltistan, renowned for its natural beauty, indigenous knowledge, and culture of peace and hospitality, provides an exceptional environment for academic growth.
Spanning over an area of 70,000 sq. Km, Baltistan is home to the world's greatest mountain ranges outside the polar regions. Its valleys, peaks, glaciers, and lakes collectively create a natural university without walls. Every year, thousands of visitors, researchers, and nature enthusiasts visit this region. Amid a matchless environment, our university proudly serves as a beacon of opportunity and learning.
By integrating entrepreneurial thinking, creative problem-solving, and advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence, we are developing an academic ecosystem that bridges locally rooted knowledge with global standards of excellence. We aim to instill in our students the skills of critical thinking, intellectual independence, and creativity, addressing the socio-economic needs of our region while adhering to international standards.
We also intend to prepare graduates who can become exemplary hosts for global tourism, curators of ecological preservation, and ambassadors of our region's exceptional natural beauty. Our faculty and administrative teams collaborate to create a student-focused environment that fosters academic growth through an interactive learning experience, innovation, and exploration of new opportunities.
As we evolve, we intend to focus on making the University not only a provider of degrees but a catalyst for employability, entrepreneurship, and professional growth. We intend to strengthen our engagement with industry, government, tourism stakeholders, and local enterprises to align academic programs with emerging economic and technological needs and opportunities.
Efforts are already underway to promote innovation in sustainable tourism, renewable energy, organic agriculture, cultural heritage, and the development of eco-friendly interventions. At the same time, we recognize the global transformation brought by digital technologies and artificial intelligence; therefore, we are integrating digital literacy, ICT skills, and AI-supported learning into our academic programs and training so that our students remain competitive on both national and international platforms.
Baltistan's landscape itself is a living classroom, offering rich opportunities for inquiry in ecology, geology, environmental science, agriculture, tourism, and cultural studies. Our vision is to transform the University into a center of knowledge to address local challenges through actionable solutions that benefit our communities and contribute to broader scientific understanding.
I invite all students, faculty, staff, alumni, and partners to join us in this exciting journey of building a university that not only provides quality education but also serves as a catalyst for positive change in our region and beyond.
Together, let us harness the unique potential of our location and heritage to create an institution that stands as a testament to the power of education in transforming lives and communities.
With warm regards and commitment to excellence,

title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content:
Skardu, Pakistan: Prof. Dr. Abdul Matin, Dean, Faculty of Natural
Sciences & Technologies, University of Baltistan, Skardu, has secured an
international award under the World Meningitis Day 2026 Advocacy Fund for his
project entitled “Youth Against Meningitis: Awareness, Advocacy and Action for
World Meningitis Day 2026 in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan.”
The project was selected through a competitive international review process
supported by the Meningitis Research Foundation (MRF), United Kingdom, through
the Confederation of Meningitis Organisations (CoMO), and is one of six
projects funded globally under the World Meningitis Day 2026 Advocacy Fund.
The three-month initiative, being implemented during August–October
2026, will focus on strengthening meningitis awareness and advocacy among young
people and communities in Gilgit-Baltistan. Planned activities include student
engagement, awareness sessions, educational outreach, advocacy activities,
social-media engagement and activities marking World Meningitis Day on 5
October 2026.
As part of the initiative, 20 student volunteers will be selected and
trained as World Meningitis Ambassadors to support meningitis awareness and
outreach activities among students and in local communities.
The University of Baltistan, Skardu will provide an important academic
platform for the implementation of major project activities, particularly youth
engagement, awareness and ambassador training. Faculty members and students
will have opportunities to participate in the initiative.
The project represents an important opportunity to promote
public-health awareness, youth leadership and community engagement while
strengthening the University's links with national and international
public-health networks. It also reflects the University's commitment to
interdisciplinary engagement in areas including public health, microbiology,
environmental health and One Health.
The initiative will be implemented in collaboration with relevant
educational institutions, health professionals, community stakeholders and
other partners in Gilgit-Baltistan.
The project is expected to contribute to greater awareness of
meningitis among young people and communities while creating opportunities for
future collaboration, research, capacity building and evidence-based advocacy
related to meningitis prevention and public health.

Introduction
The Directorate of Professional & Skill Development is dedicated to enhance professional capabilities of faculty, staff, and the wider community through policy reforms, comprehensive training programs, workshops, and certifications. The directorate was initially established as Professional Development Center in 2018. Later on, it was renamed as Directorate of Skill and Professional Development. In November 2025, the Directorate of Professional Development was constituted as a full-fledged directorate to cater to the needs of professional development within the university and the society at large. However, in March 2026, the directorate of Professional Development and Directorate of Professional Development were once again merged together as the "Directorate of Professional & Skill Development".
We bridge the gap between theory and practice with the aim to equip the stakeholders with relevant knowledge, skills, and expertise for the contemporary society and equip the youth with relevant skills as per the needs of the 21st Century. The Directorate serves as a center for lifelong learning, offering both short-term skill development courses and comprehensive certification programs. We focus on practical, hands-on training that enables participants to apply their learning immediately in professional settings.
Through industry collaborations and expert-led training, we aim to create a skilled workforce that contributes to regional economic development and meets the evolving demands of the job market.

About University of Baltistan, Skardu
Empowering minds at the roof of the world since 2010. A premier institution dedicated to academic excellence, research innovation, and community development in Gilgit-Baltistan.
A Legacy of Excellence at the Roof of the World
University of Baltistan, Skardu was established on August 25, 2017, under the "University of Baltistan Order 2016" as a federal public-sector university. The University facilitates an opportunity for all persons irrespective of gender, religion, race, creed, class, color, or domicile. Earlier, as a higher educational institution, the university started functioning as a sub-campus of Karakoram International University in 2011 with four departments including Computer Science, Modern Languages, Business Management, and Educational Development. The Department of Biological Sciences was initiated in 2017 hence increasing the number of departments to five.
The University of Baltistan, Skardu is a public-sector university and the only higher education institution offering various degree programs in the region. The establishment of this university has a multitude of prospects in the future for the local, national, and international students. Currently, the University offers admissions in BS and Masters Programs in various departments such as Computer Science, Modern Languages, Biological Sciences, Mathematics, Business Management, Tourism and Hospitality, Chemistry, Environmental Science, and Educational Development.
The geostrategic location of the university provides a strong foundation for current and future endeavors. Baltistan is situated in the lap of the two largest mountain ranges, i.e., Himalaya and Karakoram, in the extreme north of Pakistan. The region is composed of several enchanting valleys including Skardu, Khapulu, Shigar, Kharmang, Gultari, and Roundu. Skardu is the capital city of the entire region. The region abounds with natural resources, landscapes, and unique climatic conditions. It hosts some of the largest glacial ranges such as Baltoro, Biafo, Siachen, Trango, and Godwin-Austen. The region is home to five summits which are more than 8000 meters. Among them, K2 is the second-highest peak in the world. In addition, a cluster of 150 world-famous mountain peaks is also located in this terrain. Deosai, the world's highest plateau, is also located in Baltistan. Indus River, one of the longest rivers of the world, creeps crossing different valleys of Baltistan till it rushes towards the North-west into the gorge Roundu and adjacent valleys. Several natural and artificial lakes increase the beauty of this terrain. There are hundreds of thousands of herbal medicinal plants in this region. Other than these, Baltistan is also famous for mining, wildlife, built heritage, unique cultural customs, and games (polo, skiing, etc). The mesmerizing features of Baltistan attract thousands of national and international tourists and researchers every year. Therefore, all the programs and activities in the university are the mirror reflection of enriched local resources of the vicinity. The university plays a pivotal role in the socio-economic and educational development of the region and nation through robust and contextually relevant programs.

Our Vision
"To become a global leader in environmental stewardship and sustainable development, harnessing the unique natural heritage of Gilgit-Baltistan, and safeguarding the ecological integrity of the Third Pole, Water Towers of South Asia, and the highest mountain ranges of the world for future generations."

"To advance knowledge, innovation, and community engagement in environmental conservation, sustainable resource management, and eco-friendly technologies, while promoting cultural heritage and socio-economic development in Gilgit-Baltistan, with a focus on:"
• Protecting and preserving the region's fragile ecosystems, glaciers, rivers, and natural habitats
• Conducting cutting-edge research and education in environmental sciences, sustainability, and climate change
• Fostering community-based initiatives and partnerships for environmental conservation and sustainable development
• Showcasing the region's unique biodiversity hotspots, including Deosai, Central Karakorum, and Khunjrab National Parks
• Empowering local communities to become custodians of their natural resources and cultural heritage

Success Story
I graduated in 2017 from Karakoram International University (KIU), Skardu Campus — now proudly known as the University of Baltistan, Skardu (UOBS). My time at the university played a transformative role in shaping both my technical foundation and professional mindset.
I remain deeply grateful to my mentor, the late Dr. Irshad Ali, whose guidance, wisdom, and encouragement had a lasting impact on my life. He believed in nurturing not just academic excellence but also confidence and character in his students. His mentorship helped me think beyond limitations and strive for continuous growth. I also sincerely appreciate all my respected teachers whose dedication, knowledge, and support built the strong foundation upon which my career stands today.
Shortly after graduation, I moved to Karachi to pursue my career in the IT industry. I began my professional journey at Sator IT as a .NET intern. Through persistence, continuous learning, and hard work, I steadily progressed within the organization. Over the years, I became one of the most senior and trusted team members. In August 2025, I resigned while serving as a Senior Software Architect — a journey that began from an internship and evolved into a leadership role.
Alongside my professional development, I completed my Master’s degree in Software Engineering in 2021, further strengthening my technical expertise and leadership capabilities.
In September 2025, I moved to Slovakia after receiving a job offer from a new IT company, marking an important international milestone in my career.
My journey from KIU Skardu Campus (now UOBS) to working internationally reflects the power of education, mentorship, and determination. I hope my story inspires students to believe in themselves, remain resilient, and never stop learning.

content:
Introduction
The Office of Research, Innovation & Commercialization (ORIC) at the University of Baltistan, Skardu functions as the focal point for coordinating, strengthening, and promoting research and innovation activities across the university. Established in alignment with the guidelines of the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan, ORIC is dedicated to institutionalizing research governance, enhancing research quality, and fostering an enabling environment for scholarly excellence. ORIC provides strategic direction for research planning, grant acquisition, industry linkages, and intellectual property management. It facilitates collaboration among faculty, students, industry partners, and national and international organizations to ensure impactful and solution-oriented research. The office also monitors funded projects, ensures compliance with regulatory frameworks, and promotes ethical research practices. By supporting innovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialization initiatives, ORIC aims to translate academic research into practical applications that contribute to socio-economic development, particularly within Gilgit-Baltistan and beyond. content:
Event Overview
The University of Baltistan, Skardu, has launched a two-day programme of Independence Day celebrations featuring various academic, creative, and patriotic competitions. In his message, Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Masood Akhtar said Independence Day is an opportunity to renew the national commitment to Pakistan’s development, stability, and intellectual progress. He appreciated the students’ enthusiasm and participation, saying that the youth are the nation’s greatest asset. In the first round of the Urdu Speech Competition, 18 students participated, out of whom six qualified for the final based on their outstanding performances. The finalists included Nihal Ali, Urooj Fatima, and Naila Parveen from the Department of Computer Science; Pakiza Hassan and Aliza from the Department of English; and Tahira Batool from the Department of Education. A total of 12 contestants participated in the Painting Competition and showcased their artistic abilities. Suraiya Batool from the Department of Educational Development secured first position, Zahra Batool from Software Engineering secured second position, while Shaista Jabeen from the Department of Educational Development secured third position. The celebrations will conclude on August 14 at 10:00 a.m. with a flag-hoisting ceremony, national songs, cake cutting, and final rounds of the competitions. Certificates and prizes will be distributed among the winners at the conclusion of the programme.

title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content: September 08, 2026: A monitoring team from the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan visited the Technology Incubation Center (TIC) Kharmang to review its activities and progress. Director ORIC, Dr. Munawwar Ali Abbas, warmly welcomed the HEC monitoring team and briefed them about the initiatives and activities being carried out through the Technology Incubation Centers established by the University of Baltistan, Skardu, in Shigar, Ghanche, Kharmang, and Skardu. He highlighted the University's efforts to provide skills development, entrepreneurship opportunities, and capacity-building programs for the youth of the region. The HEC team appreciated the activities and efforts of the University of Baltistan, Skardu, and assured their full cooperation and support in the future to further strengthen and expand the TICs. During the briefing, the Director ORIC also conveyed the vision of the Vice Chancellor, Prof. Dr. Masood Akhter, regarding the main objectives of the Technology Incubation Centers, particularly the engagement and empowerment of local youth through diverse skills and livelihood opportunities, including livestock management, agriculture, entrepreneurship, freelancing, digital marketing, handicrafts, and other market-oriented skills. At the end of the visit, HEC Director Monitoring Dr. Bashir Khan and Deputy Director Monitoring Mr. Yasir Anwar distributed certificates among the participants who successfully completed the training programs.

The Treasurer Office of the University of Baltistan plays a central role in ensuring the financial integrity, transparency, and sustainability of the University. title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content: The 13th meeting of the Senate of the University of Baltistan, Skardu (UoBS), was held on Thursday September 10,2026 under the chairmanship of Mr. Afzal Ali Shigri, Chairman Senate. The meeting was attended by Prof. Dr. Masood Akhtar, Vice Chancellor UoBS; Dr. Farkhanda Manzoor; Prof. Dr. Ishtiaq Ali, HEC Nominee; Mr. Agha Waseem Ahmed, Joint Secretary Ministry of Kashmir Affairs and Gilgit-Baltistan, Raja Rashid Ali, Secretary Higher Education, Gilgit-Baltistan; Mr. Mehr Dad; Mr. Muhammad Zaheer; Dr. Alamdar Hussain; Dr. Muhammad Issa; Mr. Nasir Abbas; and Dr. Mir Alam, Registrar as Secretary Senate. The Senate approved a range of measures relating to governance, academic restructuring, institutional development, affiliation, human resources and financial management. Key decisions included alignment of faculties and departments with the First Statutes and HEC requirements, strengthening of the Directorate of Advanced Studies and Research (DASR), approval of new and renewed affiliations to colleges, amendments to leave rules, and approval of the UoBS Adjunct Faculty Policy, 2026. The Senate also approved the University’s Actual Budget for FY 2024-25, Revised/Actual Budget for FY 2025-26 and Budget Estimates for FY 2026-27. The Annual Report 2025 was also presented. Chairman Senate Mr. Afzal Ali Shigri appreciated the University administration’s efforts towards institutional development and emphasized the timely implementation of the Senate’s decisions. Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Masood Akhtar briefed the Senate on the University’s progress and future roadmap, with emphasis on academic excellence, research and institutional strengthening.

Introduction
The Directorate of Student Affairs at the University of Baltistan, Skardu is committed to fostering a disciplined, respectful, and academically supportive campus environment in line with the University's statutory framework. It oversees the implementation of the University's Code of Conduct, ensuring adherence to institutional policies on discipline, ethical behavior, professional decorum, and civic responsibility, thereby promoting integrity, accountability, and institutional harmony.
The Directorate also provides comprehensive support to students in planning and executing inter, intra, and extracurricular activities, including academic competitions, cultural and recreational programs, seminars, workshops, national day celebrations, sports events, galas and educational visits. It offers guidance on financial, administrative, and logistical requirements to ensure the successful organization of these activities.
In addition, the Directorate addresses student concerns through counseling, appropriate interventions, and, where necessary, parental engagement, fostering a safe, inclusive, and vibrant campus environment. By combining regulatory oversight with proactive support, the Directorate enhances student development, leadership, and holistic engagement, contributing to a dynamic and thriving university community.

Our Vision
The Directorate of Student Affairs (DSA) aspires to be a center of excellence in student development, cultivating holistic growth, ethical conduct, resilience, and environmental stewardship. Through innovative and inclusive programs, the DSA empowers students with the knowledge, skills, and values necessary to succeed academically, contribute meaningfully to society, and embrace responsible citizenship.

The Department of Mathematics is one of the pioneer disciplines of the university, established in 2019. It comprises highly qualified faculty members, with most actively engaged in research across applied, pure, and computational mathematics. title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content:
Introduction
The Faculty of Life Sciences at University of Baltistan is envisioned as a center of excellence for education, research, innovation, and community engagement in the biological and health sciences. Established in the unique ecological and geographical landscape of Gilgit-Baltistan, the Faculty seeks to harness the immense potential of the region’s rich biodiversity, alpine ecosystems, indigenous livestock resources, medicinal plants, and unique microbial diversity for sustainable development and scientific advancement.
Gilgit-Baltistan is recognized as one of the world’s important ecological regions, possessing diverse flora and fauna, high-altitude rangelands, glaciers, freshwater resources, and endemic wildlife species. The region serves as a natural laboratory for scientific exploration in biodiversity conservation, wildlife ecology, climate change, mountain agriculture, livestock management, biotechnology, public health, and environmental sustainability. In response to these opportunities and regional needs, the Faculty of Life Sciences has been established with an interdisciplinary approach to produce skilled professionals, researchers, and innovators capable of addressing emerging biological, environmental, veterinary, and health-related challenges.
In its initial phase, the Faculty comprises the Departments of Zoology, Botany, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Veterinary Sciences, and Health Sciences. These departments are strategically designed to promote research and academic excellence in areas such as wildlife conservation, medicinal and alpine plants, microbial diversity, biotechnology applications, livestock and yak management, zoonotic disease surveillance, food security, and public health improvement. The Faculty aims to integrate modern scientific knowledge with indigenous wisdom and local resources to contribute effectively to the socio-economic uplift of Gilgit-Baltistan and beyond.
Through quality education, applied research, and collaboration with national and international institutions, the Faculty of Life Sciences aspires to become a leading academic and research hub in mountain biology, biodiversity conservation, veterinary sciences, and health innovation.
Our Mission
To advance knowledge in life sciences through innovative research, quality education, and community engagement for sustainable development.
Our Vision
To become a nationally and internationally recognized center of excellence in life sciences education, research, and innovation, dedicated to the sustainable utilization and conservation of the unique biodiversity, natural resources, livestock wealth, and public health systems of Gilgit-Baltistan and other mountain regions.

Success Story
I graduated from the University of Baltistan, Skardu (UOBS) in 2017, and my journey since then has been driven by a deep passion for research and innovation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Graphically Surgical Simulation.
My time at UOBS played a fundamental role in shaping my academic foundation, critical thinking abilities, and determination to pursue higher education.
The supportive academic environment at UOBS encouraged me to explore complex problem-solving and develop a strong interest in computational methods and graphics-based simulations. The knowledge and confidence I gained there motivated me to continue my academic journey internationally.
Currently, I am pursuing my PhD at Soonchunhyang University, South Korea, in the Computer Graphics Lab.
My research focuses on advanced particle-based simulations, Fluid Dynamics, Bone Healing Simulation and real-time visualization techniques. I was honored to receive the Best Conference Paper Award at an IEEE international conference held in Malaysia. I also successfully published a Q1-ranked research paper, marking an important milestone in my research career.
These achievements reflect not only personal dedication but also the strong educational foundation built during my undergraduate studies at UOBS. I remain grateful to my teachers and mentors who encouraged me to aim higher and pursue excellence.

Mr. Kacho Zahid Hussain completed his bachelor's degree in Botany from the University of Baltistan, Skardu, where he developed a strong foundation in scientific thinking, discipline, and problem-solving skills. During his academic journey, he remained committed to personal growth, academic excellence, and character building – qualities that later proved instrumental in his professional success.
After graduation, Mr. Zahid pursued his goal of serving society through law enforcement. His determination, consistent effort, and strong educational background enabled him to qualify for a competitive selection process, leading to his appointment as an Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) in the Police Department of Gilgit-Baltistan.

University of Baltistan, Skardu (UoBS)
Strategic Development Plan (2025–2035)
Introduction
University of Baltistan is located at the geostrategic location of Baltistan northern Pakistan
bordering with China and India. It is at the basecamps of the glaciers of the Third Pole and the
wonders of the Karakoram and the Himalayas rich in both natural and cultural resources. The
University is cognizant of the opportunities, resources and challenges and aspiration of the local
communities. Being the only institution of higher learning, it aspires to play key role in the
sustainable socio -economic develop ment and wellbeing of the people with a pluralist and
multidisciplinary approach in research and innovation. Primarily the mandate of the university is
to produce human resources of required futuristic skills and knowledge. Secondly it has to
facilitate stakeholders with informed and data driven policies and practices. This policy document
aims to chalk out the envisioned development plan for the university. Vision
"We aspire to foster academic excellence and create an enabling environment to nurture human
capabilities for sustainable socio-economic development for all."
Mission Statement
"To provide inclusive, high-quality education and foster innovative research that leverages local
resources, technology, and AI to drive sustainable socio -economic development while nurturing
a pluralistic and progressive culture."
Core Values
• Human Dignity
• Moral Sanctity
• Social Justice
• Peace and Tolerance
• Eco-friendliness
Strategic Goals and Objectives
Goal 1: To Ensure Academic Excellence
• Develop and implement innovative curricula integrating local context with global
standards.
• Expand and strengthen Faculties and Disciplines:
[Page 4]
Page 4 of 10
1. Natural & Life Sciences – Biotechnology, Climate Sciences & Glaciology,
Physics, Geosciences and Mineralogy, Nutrition & Agriculture. 2. Social Sciences & Humanities – Psychology, Special Education, Early
Childhood Education, Literature and Aesthetics. 3. Health Sciences (new) – Nursing, Medical Lab Technology, Public Health,
Pharmacy, allied diplomas/certifications/degrees. 4. Professional institutions in Medicine (MBBS) and Engineering Degree
programs and Diplomas (Civil, Mining & Electrical/Electronics, etc.) –
envisioned programs.
• Ensure student–faculty ratios as per national and international standards.
• Organize annual faculty development programs and international exchange initiatives.
• Provide state of the art academic infrastructure,
• Operationalize the Public Examination Board.
• Establishment of multiple institutes and schools of unique programs
Goal 2: To Foster Research Culture and Development
• Establish Centres of Excellence for R&D focused on:
o Medicinal plants, biodiversity, and mineral resource utilization.
o Climate change adaptation, glaciology, and disaster management.
o AI-driven applied solutions and patents.
• Strengthen the Office of Research, Innovation & Commercialization (ORIC).
• Build state-of-the-art Research Laboratories for sustainability and community
facilitation
• Forging strategic research partnerships with leading national and international
universities and research centres, including student exchange programs for academic and
professional enrichment. Goal 3: Focus on Technology Integration
• Implement digital transformation initiatives across academic and administrative
functions.
• Deploy AI-powered research tools and platforms.
• Upgrade IT infrastructure and improve high-speed internet connectivity across campus.
[Page 5]
Page 5 of 10
• Establish technical incubation centres for skills development, freelancing, and business
incubation in IT/AI sectors.
• Develop globally accessible web platforms and mobile applications for ODL services,
promoting local products, services, and tourism potential.
• Provide Technology based examination and assessment services by the Examination
Board, introduce E-assessment practices.

content:
administrative functions. • Deploy AI-powered research tools and platforms. • Upgrade IT infrastructure and improve high-speed internet connectivity across campus. [Page 5] Page 5 of 10 • Establish technical incubation centres for skills development, freelancing, and business incubation in IT/AI sectors. • Develop globally accessible web platforms and mobile applications for ODL services, promoting local products, services, and tourism potential. • Provide Technology based examination and assessment services by the Examination Board, introduce E-assessment practices.
Goal 4: To Ensure Community Engagement
• Establish outreach programs promoting cultural heritage, environmental conservation,
and tourism.
• Develop archives of indigenous knowledge, innovative local solutions and heritage by
involving community experts, elders and representatives.
• Offer professional certifications, trainings, and diplomas in contextually relevant
innovative fields.
• Build strategic partnerships with local and regional stakeholders, industries, NGOs,
donor agencies, and UN offices to foster socio-economic uplift. Goal 5: To Develop Robust Infrastructure
• Build modern research facilities, smart classrooms, labs, and learning spaces. (PC-1
for R&D Labs submitted)
• Establish the Directorate of Works and Estate Care to manage ongoing projects, green
campus initiative and effective security of campus.
• Develop renewable energy solutions (solar/hybrid).
• Construct modern hostels, cafeterias, a faculty guest house, and facilitate Tourism
Department for Hospitality Services on commercial basis.
• Establish Green Campus and achieve UI Green Metric rankings.
• Establish regional centres of Open and Distance Learning (ODL).
• Enhance capacity of Gilgit sub office as Coordination/Directorate Office to enhance
coordination with GB’s key stakeholders (Government offices, NGOs, & UN agencies),
broaden academic affiliations across regional colleges, and fortify future avenues in
distance learning, project acquisition, and collaborative partnerships.
[Page 6]
Page 6 of 10
Goal 6: To Ensure Inclusive Governance
• Ensure openness, transparency and accountability across administrative levels.
• Ensure shared decision making,
• Decentralization through empowering concerned offices,
• Strengthen QEC and IQC for monitoring affiliated colleges and evaluating teaching
quality.
• Practice data driven decision making,
• Obtain annual strategic plans and KPIs from every office head, with performance
analysed annually. Goal 7: Ascertain Sustainability (align with SDGs)
• Improve capacity and retention of skilled human resources,
• Manage assets, financial resources and practices to attain financial sustainability.
• Improve the Ecosystem with green ecology, green practices and green energy options.
•
[Page 7]
Page 7 of 10
Development Plan (Phased Execution)
Short-term (2025–2027)
• Launch Faculty of Health Sciences and high-demand departments.
• Fully operationalize the Examination Board with 70% paperless assessment practices.
• Establish Coordination Office or Directorate of Afflation to facilitate and enhance
capacity/quality of affiliated colleges and secondary/ higher secondary schools.
• Faculty Development Programs. At least two weeks training program will be
scheduled during winter vacation in national institutions of relevant expertise in areas of
identified capacity building needs.
• Establish Center of Excellence for local resource-based research and innovation.
• Operationalize Directorate of Works and Estate Care to look after the ongoing
projects, green campus initiatives, repair and maintenance and security matters.
• Develop 50% of campus premises into green and initiate transition to renewable energy.
• Build new hostels and faculty guest houses.
• Facilitate Department of Tourism and Hospitality for Hospitality services under PPP
initiatives.
• Upgrade healthcare facilities with doctors, equipment, and medicines.
• Activate professional training programs targeting youth and working professionals in GB
by leveraging the diverse expertise of UoBS’s PhD faculty. Medium-term (2028–2030)
• Expand departments in Natural & Life Sciences, Social Sciences, and Health
Sciences.
• Fully operationalize the sustainability initiatives under TICs, Public Private Partnership
including Public Flower Park, Gems Value Addition, Tourism services etc.
• Achieve 80–100% renewable energy coverage.
• Strengthen national and international research collaborations.
• Build sports complexes, co-curricular centres, and an innovation hub.
• Through the Technical Incubation Centres’ (TICs) market local resources, products and
services globally using modern IT platforms.
• Develop community outreach programs to promote cultural heritage & environmental
conservation.
• Expand the public examination services of the Examination Board throughout GB and
other corners of the country.
• Develop state-of-the-art research facilities and laboratories. Will emphasize purpose-
built units with self-sufficient green energy sources (fully solarized/hybrid).
• The non-construction areas and patches of the campus will be converted into 100% green
campus with thematic garden, nursery and trees on both sides of the internal roads.
• Infrastructure development of centres/ schools in other valleys will be initiated. Long-term (2031–2035)
• Offer 50% of academic programs through international joint degrees. Establish
international partnerships for research and academic collaborations. Learning will be
made boundary less, real-time online classes with international institutions will be
introduced.
• Achieve zero-waste recycling and a model green institution.
• Establish UoBS as a regional leader in glaciology, archaeology, minerals, and tourism
research.
[Page 8]
Page 8 of 10
• Rank among the top 10 universities in Pakistan and top 100 in Asia.
• Achieve full financial sustainability through diversified revenue streams.
•
[Page 9]
Page 9 of 10
Execution Framework

title: Page 1 of 10
content:
1. Oversight & Governance
• Strategic Implementation Committee (SIC) chaired by VC.
• Annual Action Plans developed by faculties and directorates.
• Quarterly reviews and annual performance audits with transparent reporting.

title: Page 1 of 10
content:
2. Resource Identification & Allocation
• Human Resources: Recruit faculty, visiting scholars, and administrative experts per
HEC standards.
• Financial Resources: Government funding, international grants, PPPs, alumni
endowment, and commercial ventures.
• Technological Resources: AI platforms, renewable energy, advanced IT infrastructure.
• Physical Resources: Smart classrooms, labs, hostels, guest houses, healthcare units,
hotel facilities.

title: Page 1 of 10
content:
3. Ensuring Availability & Contingency Planning
• Establish a Resource Mobilization Unit under the SIC.
• Prioritize high-impact projects during funding constraints.
• Temporary infrastructure leasing and shared resources through PPP models.

title: Page 1 of 10
content:
4. Monitoring & KPIs
• Annual faculty-student ratio compliance.
• Research outputs: patents, publications, projects/grants, commercialization successes.
• Percentage renewable energy adoption and UI Green Metric ranking.
• Revenue generation through professional trainings and commercial ventures.
• International collaborations and ranking improvements.
Significance & Impact
• Addresses GB’s critical needs in healthcare, environment, tourism, and socio-economic
development.
• UOBS aspires to serve as a platform, channel and mediator for the sustainable socio-
economic growth of the region in liaison with government, national and international
stakeholders.
• Positions UoBS as a Center of Excellence in research, innovation, and sustainability.
• Generates consistent revenue streams through commercialization and tourism ventures.
• Empowers students, researchers, and youth with globally competitive skills.
• Strengthens UoBS’s national and international profile as a hub of innovation and
excellence.
Conclusion
The Strategic Framework, Development, and Execution Plan positions the University of
Baltistan, Skardu (UoBS) to emerge as a premier hub of academic excellence, research, and
innovation. Through the integration of technology, commitment to inclusivity, and pursuit of
context-driven research, UoBS is poised to drive regional socio-economic transformation while
safeguarding the unique cultural and natural heritage of Gilgit-Baltistan.

title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content:
Event Overview
The University of Baltistan, Skardu (UOBS) officially inaugurated its Three-Day Open Day 2026, welcoming prospective students, parents, educators, and members of the community to experience the University's academic environment, research culture, and educational opportunities. In his inaugural message, Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Masood Akhtar reaffirmed the University's commitment to providing quality higher education despite resource constraints. "The University of Baltistan remains dedicated to making quality higher education accessible to students within its available resources and institutional capacity. Through this Open Day, we aim to demonstrate that university education is indispensable in today's knowledge-driven world while showcasing an academic environment that proudly reflects the rich cultural heritage and traditions of Baltistan," he stated. The three-day event commenced with the participation of distinguished guests from diverse sectors of society, alongside a large number of students and visitors from educational institutions across the region. The University campus came alive with vibrant exhibitions organized by students from various academic departments, featuring innovative projects, research displays, handicrafts, entrepreneurial initiatives, and creative works that highlighted the talent and ingenuity of the University's academic community. The first day also witnessed an enthusiastic turnout of prospective students, including delegations from Public School and College, Skardu, and Fatima Jinnah Women College, Skardu. Visitors toured the University's academic blocks, lecture halls, central library, modern laboratories, and other learning facilities, gaining first-hand insight into the University's teaching and research environment. Students and faculty members from different departments delivered informative presentations introducing the University's undergraduate and postgraduate programs, research initiatives, academic achievements, and student support services. The sessions also provided visitors with valuable guidance regarding academic opportunities, career pathways, and the University's growing contribution to higher education and regional development. Speaking on the occasion, visitors commended the University administration for organizing the Open Day, describing it as an excellent initiative to connect the University with the wider community. They noted that such events play a vital role in helping prospective students make informed educational choices while fostering awareness of the importance of higher education in the socio-economic development of Gilgit-Baltistan and Pakistan. The University of Baltistan Open Day 2026 will continue over the next two days, offering visitors additional opportunities to explore academic departments, interact with faculty members and students, visit research laboratories, and learn about the University's diverse academic programs, innovation initiatives, and vibrant campus life. The Open Day reflects the University's ongoing mission to strengthen access to higher education, encourage academic excellence, promote research and innovation, and build meaningful partnerships with schools, colleges, industry, and the wider community.

title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content:
Introduction
The first comprehensive envisioned document titled “Future Plan of the University of Baltistan Skardu” is a comprehensive university strategic plan that was endorsed by the statutory bodies as well. The Future Plan has four bullet points related to Heritage Studies and Archaeology. The top one was: Institute of Archaeology, Cultural Studies, Buddhism, Bon tradition, and Islam with museum. Other envisioned points are: Establishment of ‘Kesar Cultural Center’ for Heritage Studies; Establishment of an International Center for Study and Preservation of Balti and other local languages; Establishment of an Area Study Center for Tibetan Studies (Tibet, Ladakh & Little Tibet).
Based on this Future Plan, the university continued its deliberations to implement these initiatives. Baltistan shares a deep cultural lineage with Tibet and Ladakh. The region’s archaeological rock carvings, inscriptions, architecture, and artifacts depict the great civilizations of the Bon tradition, Buddhism, Islamic Sufism, and also provide evidence of other religious traditions such as Jainism, Christianity, and Judaism. Together, these features make this part of the world an open museum of civilizations. The University of Baltistan, realizing its role as a key guardian and custodian of this heritage, has been engaged in deliberations to establish a formal institute or department.
As a result of the efforts of the worthy Vice Chancellor and the first Director of External Linkages, Dr. Zakir Hussain Zakir, Boston Architectural College (USA) was ready to submit a joint project on heritage conservation to the US Embassy for funding. The proposal was jointly developed, and after a lengthy process of evaluation, it was approved.
Following the project approval, the Office of the Director Academics placed the agenda for the establishment of the “Department of Archaeology and Heritage Studies” before the 5th Academic Council, and it was approved. For the establishment of this department, resources for a major part of human resource development, learning materials, curriculum development, library, digital archives, and an archaeological laboratory would be available from the project.
As per the agreement with the partners, the university developed an international standard curriculum for BS Archaeology and Heritage Studies in collaboration with experts from Boston Architectural College (USA). With this curriculum, which is aligned with the HEC guidelines, the BS program in Archaeology and Heritage Studies has been started. The process of developing the vision, mission, objectives of the department, program objectives, and learning outcomes has been finalized. The selection of courses, with a bifurcation into ‘Archaeology’ and ‘Heritage Studies’ tracks from the third year, has been agreed upon. For practical learning, an Archaeology Field School is being established in Shigar, and the development of Digital Archives is in progress.

title: University of Baltistan, Skardu
content:
Introduction
The Department of Languages and Cultural Studies was established in 2012 as part of Karakoram International University, Skardu Campus, which was later upgraded in 2017 to a federally chartered university, University of Baltistan, Skardu. Since its inception, the department has been dedicated to excellence in research and teaching in languages, literatures, and cultures. It is keen to provide a dynamic academic and research environment, aimed at equipping students with strong linguistic, literary, analytical, and intercultural competencies, to prepare them for a range of professions in academia, research, media, public service, and others. The outcome-based learning provided by the department fosters critical inquiry and the convergence of cutting-edge digital and interdisciplinary skills and approaches. Apart from its usual academic focus, the department particularly focuses on documentation, preservation, and critical study of the rich literary, linguistic, and cultural heritage of Gilgit-Baltistan, rooting it in the broader national and international milieu. From its establishment, the department has always upheld a key role in shaping the academic identity of the institution. Today, it proudly stands as a leading department in intellectual vigor and rigor, research production, and meaningful contribution to the academic, literary, linguistic, and cultural landscape of Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, and beyond.

The department envisions itself as a center that fosters intellectual inquiry, cultural research, documentation, and preservation, and focuses on impactful research and socio-cultural development, contributing to the academic advancement of Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, and the wider world.
Our Mission
The mission of the Department of Languages and Cultural Studies at the University of Baltistan, Skardu, is to promote excellence in teaching, research, and community engagement in the fields of language, literature, culture, and intercultural studies. The department is committed to preserving and promoting the rich literary, linguistic, and cultural heritage of Baltistan and the broader Himalayan–Karakoram region, while fostering critical thinking, intercultural understanding, and global perspectives. Through innovative academic programs, scholarly research, and inclusive dialogue, the department aims to develop competent, ethical, and socially responsible graduates who make meaningful contributions to local, national, and international communities.
